【文章原文节选】: Official Claude Code Extension Compromise: Security Advisory | Phorion 🎉 Phorion ranked #1 in independent EDR telemetry evaluations. Learn more Features Detecting Threats Behavioral detection and threat hunting Protecting Endpoints File access controls and hash blocking Responding to Incidents Live response and device isolation Endpoint Visibility Deep telemetry via Apple's ESF Pricing About Us Blog Book a Demo October 30, 2026 Updated October 31, 2026 By Calum Hall Official Claude Code Extension Compromise: Security Advisory SSH Backdoor Cursor Marketplace VS Code macOS Linux Windows Threat Report TL;DR Phorion has detected a backdoor in the official Claude Code for VS Code extension bundle on the Cursor Marketplace that drops a persistent SSH backdoor across macOS, Linux, and Windows. This write-up focuses primarily on macOS, where the extension attempts to configure an SSH backdoor and establish persistence. Organisations should immediately review their environments for use of Claude Code for VSCode 2.1.312 or 2.1.313 and engage incident response where use of the extension is discovered. Update (31 October 2026): Cursor’s security notice now identifies versions 2.1.312 and 2.1.3
